name: Flynn Moore
source:
Flynn Moore is one of the main characters of "Echo". Flynn was born and raised in Echo to a Mormon family. He continues to live in Echo as Echo's town clerk for three years unopposed, and works at the town hall underneath his aunt, the town's mayor. 

Flynn has an infamously blunt and abrasive personality, not being afraid to speak his mind. Despite this, he often struggles with communicating his true intentions, choosing instead to remain quiet and aloof. He often displays sexual tendencies that may seem inappropriate, even among his closest friends.
